title: Ligue 1 Player of the Year 2000/01 to 2009/10
brief: Name the UNFP Ligue 1 Player of the Year for each season from 2000/01 to 2009/10.

notes.Marcelo Gallardo: Gallardo won it in 1999/00, the season before this board starts.
notes.Eden Hazard: Hazard won it in 2010/11 and 2011/12, just after these years.

checks: English Wikipedia's Ligue 1 Player of the Year list matched against French Wikipedia's Trophees UNFP list (which cites tropheesunfp.com): all agree for every season. Transfermarkt honours pages also list the award for Pauleta, Drogba, Juninho, Malouda and Benzema; they leave it out for Carriere, Essien, Gourcuff and Lisandro Lopez (Transfermarkt's own gap, not a disagreement). Pauleta fills two slots, under the limit. Juninho is written Juninho Pernambucano to keep him apart from the Premier League's Juninho.
